cases.title: Verify Broadcast Notification Can Be Created

steps.action: Log in to the Admin Portal using valid credentials.
steps.expected: User is successfully logged in.
The Broadcast Notifications screen is displayed.

steps.action: Click the Create New Broadcase button.
steps.expected: The Add New Broadcast Notification form is displayed.

steps.action: Type a valid notification title in the Title field.
steps.expected: The title is accepted.

steps.action: Select a valid option from the Target field
steps.expected: The selected Target is displayed.

steps.action: Type a valid message in the Message field.
steps.expected: The message is entered successfully.

steps.action: Check the required notification delivery option(s), such as Send Push and/or Send Sms.
steps.expected: The selected notification delivery options are checked.
The Broadcast Notification is successfully published and the notification is added to the Broadcast Notifications list.

cases.title: Verify Broadcast Notification Details Can Be Viewed

steps.action: Log in to the Admin Portal using valid credentials
steps.expected: User is successfully logged in.
The Broadcast Notifications screen is displayed.
The notification is displayed in the list.

steps.action: Click the View icon for the Broadcast Notification.
steps.expected: The Broadcast Notification details are displayed
The notification details, including the configured title, target, message, delivery options, and any attachment, are displayed correctly

cases.title: Verify Broadcast Notification Can Be Deleted

steps.action: Log in to the Admin Portal using valid credentials.
steps.expected: User is successfully logged in.
The Broadcast Notifications screen is displayed

steps.action: Locate the Broadcast Notification to be deleted.
steps.expected: The notification is displayed in the list.

steps.action: Click the Delete icon for the Broadcast Notification
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog is displayed with the message “Are you sure you want to delete this item?” and Cancel and OK buttons.

steps.action: Click Yes on the confirmation dialog
steps.expected: The customer is successfully deleted from the Customers list.
The deleted customer is no longer displayed in the Customers list

cases.title: Verify Broadcast Notification Can Be Edited

steps.action: Log in to the Admin Portal using valid credentials
steps.expected: User is successfully logged in.
The Broadcast Notifications screen is displayed

steps.action: Locate the Broadcast Notification to be edited.
steps.expected: The notification is displayed in the list

steps.action: Click the Edit icon for the Broadcast Notification.
steps.expected: The Broadcast Notification edit form is displayed with the existing information populated.

cases.title: Verify Broadcast Notification Can Be Withdrawn

steps.action: Log in to the Admin Portal using valid credentials
steps.expected: User is successfully logged in.
The Broadcast Notifications screen is displayed.

steps.action: Locate and open a published Broadcast Notification.
steps.expected: The Broadcast Details screen is displayed.
A Withdraw Notification confirmation dialog is displayed with the message “Are you sure you want to withdraw the notification?” and No and Yes buttons.
The Broadcast Notification is successfully withdrawn.
The Withdrawal Date is populated and the notification reflects that it has been withdrawn.

cases.title: erify Broadcast Notification Deletion Can Be Cancelled

steps.action: Log in to the Admin Portal using valid credentials.
steps.expected: User is successfully logged in.

steps.action: Locate the Broadcast Notification to be deleted.
